kubectl create secret docker-registry registry-auth --docker-server=registry:5000 --docker-username=benchmark --docker-password=benchmark-pass

# 2. Define the Deployment YAML content
DEPLOYMENT_YAML='
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: app
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: hello-container
        image: registry:5000/private/hello:1.0
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        imagePullSecrets:
        - name: registry-auth
'

# 3. Apply the deployment
echo "$DEPLOYMENT_YAML" | kubectl apply -f -
